messages:
emma: FYI: scheduled 23:00 UTC window shows router pinned to 4.2.0 but runtime build 4.3.0 landed in deploy queue. Console remains pinned to 2.7. Can we avoid a mismatch outage?
deploy-bot: automated: Deploy scheduled for 2026-06-08 23:00 UTC. Components: api=stable, runtime=4.3.0, console=2.7. Canary: 5% -> 20% -> 100%. Rollback runtime: /deploy rollback runtime 4.2.2.
raj: 4.3.0 changes connection header order and adds a new "x-rwd-session-v2" header. Router 4.2.0 ignores it and console parse expects legacy only. In staging we saw ~1.2% auth fails.
leo: Product is out for the day. I'd prefer no pin changes without them. Can runtime emit legacy header for the canary?
sre-ops: We can add a compatibility flag to runtime to emit legacy headers for 1st wave only, plus a router accept-rule to tolerate v2 headers. Router change needs infra review, but we can deploy a lightweight override to the canary routing.
emma: Let's do compatibility in runtime + router accept-rule for canary, and require manual proceed after 5% check. No pin changes.
deploy-bot: updated plan: runtime=4.3.0 canary 5% with feature-flag "compat-legacy-headers"=on. Manual proceed required. Auto-abort if auth 5xx/4xx spike >1% for 3 mins.
leo: I'll add a console metric to count header-parse errors (rwd.header.parse_error). Put an alert for quick detection.
raj: I'll prepare rollback command and a short runbook: if spike, /deploy rollback runtime 4.2.2 and open incident.
product-bot: note: @product teams notified asynchronously for visibility; pin changes require explicit approval.
emma: Preflight 22:30 UTC in #eng-releases. Tagging oncall. If infra can't apply router accept-rule, rollback is default.
sre-ops: Router accept-rule staged and verified in staging; will attempt prod apply by 22:50 UTC.
deploy-bot: preflight reminder set 22:30 UTC. Checklist: compat flag set, router rule staged, header parse metric added, manual-step enforced.
